question.text: Per Chapter 9, syndicate investments are permitted ONLY for which investor class under SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

answer.text: Only Accredited Investors — the Lead Investor must ensure every investor meets the SEBI Accredited Investor Framework.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9 expressly states that under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, only Accredited Investors are permitted to invest in syndicate deals, and the Lead Investor is required to ensure that every investor in the syndicate complies with the SEBI Accredited Investor Framework. That is exactly what Option A captures. The Trap: Option B ignores the AI-only restriction by extending eligibility to all retail investors with a PAN. Options C and D narrow eligibility to FPIs or to promoters of listed companies, neither of which the workbook prescribes for syndicate investments. Note: The workbook does not prescribe specific annual renewal or expiry mechanics for AI certificates in this passage; the operative rule being tested is that participation in syndicate deals is restricted to Accredited Investors as confirmed by the Lead Investor.
